# Project Guidelines

## Code Style
- No language-specific style rules are defined yet.
- Match the style already present in files you edit.

## Architecture
- This repository is currently a minimal bootstrap and does not define component boundaries yet.
- Current workspace footprint is intentionally minimal: [README.md](../README.md) and this instructions file.
- If you introduce a new top-level structure, document the intent in [README.md](../README.md).

## Build and Test
- No install, build, lint, or test commands are defined yet.
- Do not assume runnable build/test steps exist until tooling is explicitly added.
- If you add tooling, update [README.md](../README.md) with exact commands and then update this file.

## Conventions
- Keep changes small and task-focused.
- Do not assume a framework or runtime unless it is explicitly added to the repository.
- Link to project docs instead of duplicating them in instruction files.
